tasks.why: Adi 2026-10-08: everything the REST API and our Zoom app cannot do live must still be automated in every Day 1, 2 and 3 session: posting chat messages, running polls, posting call-to-action links at the right moments, keeping attendees muted with video off, and promoting co-hosts.
tasks.spec:
Spike done (branch zoom-bot 465d59d, docs/onboarding-v3/analysis/zoom-bot.md, sources cited). Findings: Zoom states the Meeting SDK 'is designed for human use cases and does not support bots' (verified 2026-10-08 on developers.zoom.us/docs/meeting-sdk/linux/), and only the native macOS (or Windows) Meeting SDK can launch polls; Web and Linux cannot. So no unattended bot. Plan: a Swift 'Tantra Host Console' on Adi's Mac, opened by launchd 20 minutes before each Wed to Fri 11:00 ET session; Adi presses Start and hosts from it (Zoom's normal meeting window). It locks the room (mute all, no self-unmute, no video, focus mode), runs the day's script from the centre (/bot/zoom/plan): timed chat posts, CTA links, polls created ahead by REST and launched live, makes listed co-hosts co-host, re-mutes anyone not allowed, and posts joins, leaves and poll results to /bot/zoom/events. Admin gets a per-day script editor (chat, CTAs, polls). UNVERIFIED until the first test meeting: REST polls appearing on every occurrence, stopping another person's video, co-host matching by email.

ALREADY BUILT AND LIVE (verified 2026-10-09 against main and the live centre; the console reuses all of it):
- The Zoom app that exists is the 'Tantra Centre' Server-to-Server OAuth app (T-224, done): its credentials and webhook secret are saved in the live centre (zoom_s2s_enc, zoom_webhook_enc), host prepared, webhook at /hooks/zoom. It already holds user:read:token:admin (the host's ZAK the console needs to start the meeting) and report:read:list_meeting_polls:admin (poll results), but NOT the poll write scopes in ask 3.
- One recurring meeting per cohort (87002851906 for 7 to 9 Oct), one join link for all three days, room settings applied at the account level: mute on entry, request permission to unmute, focus mode, passcode on, authentication off, audio transcript (T-223, T-224).
- The bot contract is already in cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts: GET /bot/zoom/plan (today's sessions, locks mute_all / no self-unmute / no video / focus mode, co-host emails), POST /bot/zoom/zak, POST /bot/zoom/events (started, ended, joined, left). It is OFF in production: ZOOM_BOT_KEY is not set, so /bot/zoom/plan answers 404.
- Engagement already lands without the console: chat (from the recording's CHAT file), polls, transcript and attendance go to zoom_chat, zoom_polls, zoom_engagement and the Tracker tabs; recordings are backed up to the team Drive (T-232).
- Co-hosts: no alternative hosts (one Pro licence); co-host emails are collected here (T-230 folded in). Production zoom_cohosts is empty.
- Mute and video locks: Zoom Support ticket open (T-225). If Zoom grants them, the console only needs chat, CTAs, polls and co-hosts.

STILL TO BUILD: the Swift console itself; a per-day script (timed chat posts, CTA links, polls) in the plan and an admin editor for it; poll creation by REST; /bot/zoom/events accepting poll results and chat posts (today it takes only started/ended/joined/left); setting ZOOM_BOT_KEY; the launchd opener.
